title: claudex plan critique artifact, version 1
description: The pair's critique of a proposed plan: an agree/revise verdict, plan-level findings, non-blocking implementation obligations to carry forward, missing evidence, an optional simpler alternative, and notes. Submitted for a plan-critique phase.

protocol_version.description: The protocol major version; always 1 for this schema.

message_type.description: Discriminates this message from other protocol messages.

turn_id.description: The turn this critique is submitted for.

state_revision.description: The run-state revision this submit must compare-and-swap against.

human_context.description: Disclosed local human/agent dialogue that changed requirements this turn; null when none.

requires_human_decision.description: True only for an unresolved value choice or repeated evidence-backed disagreement.

decision_question.description: The concrete question for the human, else null.

verdict.description: Whether the critic agrees with the plan or requires a revision.

findings.description: Plan-level findings; content facts belong in implementation_checks.

key.description: Stable lowercase-hyphen identifier; reuse it when the same issue recurs.

kind.description: Whether this finding is new, repeated, a regression, or a decision.

category.description: The plan-level concern this finding raises.

file.description: Repository-relative file the finding references, or null for a plan section.

line.description: Line the finding references, or null.

implementation_checks.description: Non-plan-blocking obligations carried into implementation and verification.

description.description: Concrete fact, edge case, or content requirement to verify while implementing.

action.description: Add/update this obligation, or retract it with evidence.

target_step.description: Exact plan step title, or null when cross-cutting.

missing_evidence.description: Existing repo-relative file paths omitted from the evidence manifest; empty when review is conclusive.

simpler_alternative.description: A simpler valid plan if one exists, else null.
